synergyTexts.NORMAL: NORMAL Pokémon and their ADJACENT allies gain SHIELD when combat starts, and can craft various scarves.
synergyTexts.GRASS: GRASS Pokémon heal and produce berries over time. 40% of overheal is gained as max HP.
synergyTexts.FIRE: FIRE Pokémon have a chance to BURN their enemies, and gain ATK after every attack.
synergyTexts.WATER: WATER Pokémon generate more PP and can be fished with a rod.
synergyTexts.ELECTRIC: ELECTRIC Pokémon basic attacks can trigger two additional attacks.
synergyTexts.FIGHTING: FIGHTING Pokémon block a flat amount of damage on every hit received. After 10 hits blocked, throw the melee target away, destroying their SHIELD.
synergyTexts.PSYCHIC: PSYCHIC Pokémon gain additional AP and attract Unowns.
synergyTexts.DARK: DARK Pokémon's critical hits are more powerful and more frequent. Melee Dark Pokémon jump to the farthest target reachable.
synergyTexts.STEEL: STEEL Pokémon deal a percentage of their damage as TRUE and give 3 DEF to your whole team when activated.
synergyTexts.GROUND: GROUND Pokémon dig holes on board in between stages, and gain stats based on the depth of the hole they start in. They sometimes find buried items at max depth (5 stages).
synergyTexts.POISON: POISON Pokémon have a chance to POISONNED their target for 4 seconds with their basic attacks. Poison inflicts TRUE over time
synergyTexts.DRAGON: DRAGON Pokémon amplify synergies and gain more stats when fully evolved.
synergyTexts.FIELD: When a FIELD Pokémon is KO'd, all the other FIELD Pokémon are healed and gain SPEED
synergyTexts.MONSTER: MONSTER Pokémon can FLINCH their opponents for 3 seconds ON_ATTACK. Every time they get a KO, they gain stats, heal and grow in size.
synergyTexts.HUMAN: HUMAN Pokémon heal for a percentage of the damage they deal with attacks and abilities, and can learn a new ability with TMs.
synergyTexts.AQUATIC: AQUATIC Pokémon mitigate status afflictions for all your team. After 7 seconds, a tidal wave cleans up negative status and field effects, heals your AQUATIC allies, and knocks back and damages enemies.
synergyTexts.BUG: At the start of combat spawns a copy of your STRONGEST BUG Pokémon.
synergyTexts.FLYING: FLYING Pokémon FLY_AWAY when they fall under a certain amount of HP unless affected by PARALYSIS, FREEZE, LOCKED or SLEEP.
synergyTexts.FLORA: When a FLORA Pokémon is KO'd, a Flower Pot blossoms and you collect RICH_MULCH. Higher STAR units give more mulch, which can be used to evolve your Flower Pots.
synergyTexts.ROCK: ROCK Pokémon gain DEF, better resist to critical attacks, and can adapt to weather.
synergyTexts.GHOST: GHOST applies various curses on opposing Pokémon. GHOST Pokémon have [15,LK]% chance to dodge attacks and apply SILENCE ON_HIT when synergy active.
synergyTexts.FAIRY: FAIRY Pokémon use wands to deal additional SPECIAL and various effects with their attacks.
synergyTexts.ICE: ICE Pokémon have [20,LK]% chance to FREEZE the enemy for 2 seconds after a hit and give SPE_DEF to your whole team.
synergyTexts.FOSSIL: At 30% HP, FOSSIL Pokemon awaken their primordial power, gaining SHIELD and ATK.
synergyTexts.SOUND: SOUND Pokémon emit a cry when they use their abilities, waking up sleeping allies and giving them bonus stats.
synergyTexts.ARTIFICIAL: ARTIFICIAL Pokémon give tools and gain ATK, AP and SHIELD when holding items.
synergyTexts.BABY: BABY Pokémon have a chance to bring you Pokémon Eggs to comfort you after a defeat. Chance stacks with losing streaks.
synergyTexts.LIGHT: LIGHT Pokémon reveal a spotlight on the battlefield. The Pokémon standing in the spotlight at the start of combat gains unique bonuses.
synergyTexts.WILD: WILD Pokémon are only found during PvE encounters stages when synergy is not active (6% base chance). Their attacks have [25,LK]% chance to inflict WOUND for 3 seconds.
synergyTexts.WILD_ADDITIONAL: Current chance to find a WILD Pokémon: %
synergyTexts.AMORPHOUS: AMORPHOUS Pokémon are extremely flexible and lack their own shape. Your team gains HP and SPEED by activating a wide variety of synergies.
synergyTexts.GOURMET: GOURMET Pokémon can be equipped with a CHEF_HAT. Chefs will cook up their Signature Dish between fights and feed ADJACENT allies, giving them various buffs and effects.
